name: riya-game-platformer-open-world
description: riya open world · The Open Line — all twenty-eight riya worlds stitched into ONE continuous 722-unit map you run left-to-right with a follow camera: the math window recenters on riya every frame (clamped to the world edges, with a small lead toward her facing), so the whole curriculum — number line → functions → limits → calculus → series → multivar → Fourier — is one unbroken run. Merged from the riya-level-* atoms' own data (platforms, stars, curve overlays, guides, field vectors, treasure rings, gates, pads, sequences, area fills, drift regions): each world keeps its exact terrain and pedagogy as a zone; staircase bridges climb/descend between zone exit and entry heights, and entering a zone fires a name banner and swaps the skate equation. Skating is global: every skate world's curve is concatenated into one strictly-increasing mega-curve for std-platformer-body, densely resampled (monotone cubic, kinks preserved) so the ride and the drawing are the same smooth surface. GAME ELEMENTS: ✖ patrol bugs pace beats in six zones (std-patrol-hazard) and cost a life on touch; three glowing star doors (std-gate-lock) open at 20/50/80 ★; a treasure ring floats above the Gallery bars — loop one full revolution around the floating chest (std-loop-lock tracks your winding angle: θ = 2π opens it) and it spills 5 bonus 💎★; two velocity gates (std-velocity-gate) guard bonus gems off the through-path — cross the Deriv ramp gate inside its speed band (your speed IS the derivative) and hold still at the Mountain summit (slope 0) until the dwell opens it; twelve floor pads (std-pad-lock) form one world-wide checklist — mirrored pairs on the Valley and Shifts parabolas (lighting one side demands its mirror), one pad on each Corner wall, and two ordered rows on the Volume slabs where the inner sum's row must finish before the outer's (Σ); the ground itself teaches too: Doubling's floating steps double their gaps until one beats any jump (take the spring), the Series steps converge under a bonus cluster that hovers at the limit, Decay's landing pads shrink ×0.7 each, the Pole's asymptote gets a star trail up the void, and Log's domain simply has no floor left of x = −7 — jump the gap; four area fills (std-area-fill) turn motion into painted integrals — shade the Area run's region by pacing it, climb the Accum gauge fastest on the bump's high shelf, finish the Tail's finite area long before its infinite run ends, and keep the Taylor ride-band alive only while truly skating the wave; drift fields push riya like weather — cubic's inflection tugs from both sides, the vector step is a constant right-up current, gradient's arrows are the easy path uphill, the saddle's downdraft slams every jump over the pass (the max shoves you back down to the trail), and the contour patrol bobs on a sine; checkpoints at every zone entry (std-lives) are the respawn — three lives, then game over → retry. MATH YOU FEEL: while skating, std-learn-slope-probe draws the live tangent line, a rise-over-run triangle, and a glowing curve window under riya, with a dy/dx chip in the HUD; std-fx-trail leaves a comet trail. A GIF tutorial modal (std-tutorial-overlay) teaches run/jump, skating, and stars-doors on first boot. Catch every ★ the line offers — stars and spilled gems alike — to clear it. Rendered through math-canvas on theme-token grid/axes with per-family zone bands.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.

hitRadius.label: Hit Radius

patrols.description: One row per patroller: id, the [x0, x1] beat it walks, its base y, its speed in units/s, and optionally waveAmp/wavePeriod for a vertical sine bob (waveAmp 0 = flat ping-pong). Current x/dir/t/cy/touching/hit are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.patrols — SET_PATROLS replaces it at runtime (boards that import patrols), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected patrols survive respawns.
patrols.label: Patrols

invulnMs.description: Milliseconds after a accepted hit during which further DAMAGE is ignored, so a hazard overlapping the respawn can't chain-drain.

maxLives.description: Lives seeded on INIT/RESTART; reaching zero fires GAME_OVER.

reachMargin.description: Extra world units padded around a closed gate's rect when testing player contact (approximates the body's size).

default.concept: x is a number you stand on
default.name: 1 · The Plain
default.objective: Catch 4 ★ — the line is your ground; mind the pits!

default.concept: slope = rise ÷ run = 1 ⁄ 2
default.name: 2 · The Ramp
default.objective: Climb the ramp — every step rises 1 for every 2 across. Catch 4 ★!

default.concept: y = x² ⁄ 16 — the bars are the function, sampled; the dashed mirror axis x = 0 pairs the floor pads — light one, light its mirror
default.name: 3 · The Valley
default.objective: Drop into the valley and climb its walls — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the summit is the local maximum — slope = 0 there
default.name: 4 · The Mountain
default.objective: Climb to the summit ★ — the highest point of the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the curve never touches x = 3 — the dashed wall is an asymptote; the road fades as it climbs — trust the curve
default.name: 5 · The Pole
default.objective: The world breaks at x = 3 — jump the chasm and catch 4 ★!

default.concept: 1, 2, 4, 8 — each step costs double; the road fades ahead — trust the doubling
default.name: 6 · The Doubling
default.objective: The stair doubles: 1, 2, 4, 8. Find the springboard to the top ★!

default.concept: the bars are the area under the curve — a Riemann skyline
default.name: 7 · The Gallery
default.objective: Walk the skyline — the bars trace the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a shift: (x−4) slides the whole valley 4 steps right — same shape, new address; the ↑ pad carries the road's +k — ride it and the road rises to the high ledge
default.name: 8 · Shifts
default.objective: Skate the shifted valley — ride the ↑ pad: YOU lift the road to the high ledge — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the corner: slope is −½ on the left wall and +½ on the right — at x = 0 no single slope exists; the ⤢ pad retunes the right arm's a — dive the left wall for speed, then the steeper arm reaches the high shelf
default.name: 9 · Corner
default.objective: Skate down one wall — ride the ⤢ pad at the bottom: YOU tilt the road up to the shelf — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the inflection: steep, flat, steep — the slope's own slope flips sign at x = 0; the arrows lean toward the flat middle
default.name: 10 · Inflection
default.objective: Climb the S-curve — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the logarithm: a burst upward that flattens forever — doubling run backwards; left of x = −7 it does not exist; the road fades ahead — trust the slow climb
default.name: 11 · Log
default.objective: Leave the flatlands and climb the log — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: this ramp IS the valley's slope: far from the dashed line on the steep walls, crossing it where the valley bottoms out
default.name: 12 · Derivative
default.objective: Skate the valley's slope — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the shaded region grows as you run right — piling up strips of area is integration
default.name: 13 · Area
default.objective: Run right and watch the shaded area pile up — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: accumulation: the hill climbs fastest where the dashed bump is tallest — its height collects the bump
default.name: 14 · Accumulation
default.objective: Climb the accumulating hill — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: decay: every step right loses the same fraction — the slope stays −1/5 of the height (y′ = −y/5) — the dashed line is the floor y = 0.8 it sinks toward; the road fades ahead — trust the flattening
default.name: 15 · Decay
default.objective: Ride the decay down toward the floor — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the tail runs on forever and never touches 1 — yet the area under it stays finite: an improper integral
default.name: 16 · Tail
default.objective: Chase the tail toward y = 1 — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each step is half the last: 1, ½, ¼, … — climb forever and never cross the ceiling 2; the last gap has no step — the ceiling is your answer, land on it
default.name: 17 · Series
default.objective: Climb the halving staircase — answer the limit to cross the final gap, then catch 5 ★!

default.concept: polynomials hug the wave: the line clings near 0, the cubic clings longer — infinitely many terms IS the wave
default.name: 18 · Taylor
default.objective: Skate the wave the polynomials are chasing — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: y = 0.6x + 3 has a removable hole at x = 2; the left and right branches meet at the same height, so the limit exists and the road can stitch
default.name: 19 · The Limit

default.concept: The secant slope between two points on a curve approaches the tangent slope as the points merge — average rate becomes instantaneous rate.
default.name: 20 · The Secant

default.concept: each step adds the same displacement ⟨1.6, 1⟩ — vectors add tip-to-tail
default.name: 21 · Vectors
default.objective: Walk the vector steps — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: The road is y = A·sin(B·(x − H)) + K. Touch the four glowing pads in order — A, H, B, K — to reshape the wave so every ★ is on a crest.
default.name: 22 · The Sine Wave

default.concept: slicing a hill z = f(x, y) at fixed heights gives contour lines — crowded contours mean a steep climb
default.name: 23 · Contours
default.objective: Climb the ridge across the contour levels — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the slope of z = 3 + x/4 + y/2 depends on direction: ∂z/∂x = ¼ under your feet, ∂z/∂y = ½ the dashed way
default.name: 24 · Partials
default.objective: Walk the x-slope — the dashed line is the y-slope. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the gradient ∇f points the steepest way up — the arrows always aim at the summit
default.name: 25 · Gradient
default.objective: Follow the gradient arrows to the summit — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the pass is the trail's minimum and the cross-trail's maximum at once — a saddle point; the arrows run downhill into the pass
default.name: 26 · Saddle
default.objective: Descend to the mountain pass and climb out — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each column is one sum; adding the columns across is the second sum — ∬ f dA is a sum of sums
default.name: 27 · Volume
default.objective: Climb the columns of the double sum — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a flat road plus sine harmonics builds a square-wave staircase — Fourier synthesis as terrain
default.name: 28 · Fourier

regions.description: One row per fogged world span: x-range (x0..x1) and lookAhead — how far past the player the road stays revealed while inside. Small values force prediction (blowups), large values suit slow tail lessons. Empty list = no fog anywhere.
regions.label: Fog Regions

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tracks the reveal horizon; toggle to freeze the fog where it is.
running.label: Running

gates.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.choices — SET_GATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.
gates.label: Choice Gates

reachX.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).
reachX.label: Reach X

reachY.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).
reachY.label: Reach Y

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.
running.label: Running

emits.description: The player landed grounded on the gate's correct option; fires once per gate (solved gates stop judging). Carries the gate center so boards can burst the unlock there.
The player landed grounded on a wrong option; carries the gate id, the chosen optionId, and the option's world position so boards can bounce the player back to the approach and float the gate's hint.

events.description: The player landed grounded on the gate's correct option; fires once per gate (solved gates stop judging). Carries the gate center so boards can burst the unlock there.
events.name: Choice Correct

events.description: The player landed grounded on a wrong option; carries the gate id, the chosen optionId, and the option's world position so boards can bounce the player back to the approach and float the gate's hint.
events.name: Choice Wrong

default.hint: a·f — the road steepened; only a fast dive climbs it

coefPads.description: One row per pad: id, center (x, y in world units), the mod applied to the road while inside x0..x1 (a scales slope+height, b compresses/stretch period, h shifts horizontally, k lifts), and the hint floated on apply, and hop (true = the board teleports the player onto the reshaped surface — use when the mod steps the road far from the pad; false = the skate snap carries the player, preserving speed). applied is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.coefPads — SET_PADS replaces it at runtime (boards that import pads), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected pads survive respawns.
coefPads.label: Coefficient Pads

reachX.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).
reachX.label: Reach X

reachY.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers riding the surface the pad sits on).
reachY.label: Reach Y

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED applies touched pads; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.
running.label: Running

emits.description: The player stood on an unapplied coefficient pad; carries the pad position and the full mod (x0, x1, a, b, h, k) so the board appends it to the body authority's curveMods and hops the player onto the reshaped road. Fires once per pad per run.
Every coefficient pad in the set is applied; fires once per run. Boards layer the completion fx and dismiss the zone card.

events.description: The player stood on an unapplied coefficient pad; carries the pad position and the full mod (x0, x1, a, b, h, k) so the board appends it to the body authority's curveMods and hops the player onto the reshaped road. Fires once per pad per run.
events.name: Coef Pad Applied

events.description: Every coefficient pad in the set is applied; fires once per run. Boards layer the completion fx and dismiss the zone card.
events.name: Coef Pad Set Completed

effects.hint: a·f — the road steepened; only a fast dive climbs it

minSpeed.description: Body speed (units/s, from BODY_MOVED) below which no dot is appended, so a resting body doesn't pile dots on one spot.
minSpeed.label: Min Speed

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED appends trail dots; toggle to freeze the trail (existing dots still age out).
running.label: Running

ttl.description: Milliseconds a trail dot lives; at a 33ms move cadence ~600ms keeps the last eighteen positions. The ttl is also the natural length cap — no separate limit needed.
ttl.label: Trail Ttl (ms)

curve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) of the graph being ridden — the same table the body skates and the canvas draws, so the readout matches what is underfoot. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.curve — SET_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
curve.label: Curve

running.description: When true the probe derives the readout off BODY_MOVED; toggle to freeze it (the board hides the tangent overlays when probing goes stale).
running.label: Running

triRun.description: Horizontal leg of the rise-over-run triangle; the vertical leg is slope × triRun, so triRun = 1 reads the slope directly.
triRun.label: Triangle Run

window.description: Half-length (world units along the tangent) of the tangent segment and of the glow sample window around the contact point.
window.label: Tangent Window

emits.description: The local dy/dx crossed a 0.5 bucket boundary while the probe was active; slope is exact, bucket is the rounded step — fx/HUD scale with steepness without paying per-tick events.

events.description: The local dy/dx crossed a 0.5 bucket boundary while the probe was active; slope is exact, bucket is the rounded step — fx/HUD scale with steepness without paying per-tick events.
events.name: Slope Changed

autoShow.description: When true the tutorial opens on INIT for this run; when false it stays hidden until SHOW.
autoShow.label: Auto Show

previewTrait.description: Trait rendered in the media position of the modal — the live, demo-driven preview of the mechanic (a bare game canvas, no shell chrome). '@trait.TutorialEmptyPreview' leaves the slot blank. Override with '@trait.<TraitName>' to show a board's live frame.
previewTrait.label: Preview trait

default.title: Run & jump

steps.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.
steps.label: Steps

emits.description: Self-emitted on INIT when autoShow is on — opens step one. (A config-valued INIT guard would be constant-folded at compose time and misfire; the self-event keeps the decision in an effect.)
Advance one step; on the last step it finishes the tutorial (marks done, clears the overlay, emits TUTORIAL_DONE).
Return one step (inert on the first).
Skip/close the tutorial; marks done and clears the overlay.
Re-open the tutorial from step one — wire a board's help button here.
The tutorial was finished or skipped; boards unpause or log completion.
Emitted when a tutorial step carrying a demoId is shown; the composed std-tutorial-autodemo atom plays that scripted demo.
Emitted when the tutorial leaves a demo step (next/back) or is dismissed/finished; the autodemo atom stops and releases control.

events.description: Self-emitted on INIT when autoShow is on — opens step one. (A config-valued INIT guard would be constant-folded at compose time and misfire; the self-event keeps the decision in an effect.)
events.name: Tut Auto

events.description: Re-open the tutorial from step one — wire a board's help button here.
events.name: Show

events.description: Advance one step; on the last step it finishes the tutorial (marks done, clears the overlay, emits TUTORIAL_DONE).
events.name: Tut Next

events.description: Return one step (inert on the first).
events.name: Tut Back

events.description: Skip/close the tutorial; marks done and clears the overlay.
events.name: Tut Dismiss

events.description: The tutorial was finished or skipped; boards unpause or log completion.
events.name: Tutorial Done

events.description: Emitted when a tutorial step carrying a demoId is shown; the composed std-tutorial-autodemo atom plays that scripted demo.
events.name: Tutorial Demo Start

events.description: Emitted when the tutorial leaves a demo step (next/back) or is dismissed/finished; the autodemo atom stops and releases control.
events.name: Tutorial Demo Stop

arrowOffsetY.description: World units above riya's center where the velocity arrow originates.
arrowOffsetY.label: Player Vector Arrow Offset Y

arrowScale.description: Scale factor for riya's live velocity vector arrow, matching the standalone vector world.
arrowScale.label: Player Vector Arrow Scale

camLead.description: How far ahead of riya (toward her facing) the follow camera centers, in world units.
camLead.label: Camera Lead

checkpointColor.description: Marker color for the 🚩 checkpoint flags (success green, both themes).
checkpointColor.label: Checkpoint Color

checkpoints.description: One checkpoint per zone entry (mirrors OwLives.checkpoints); rendered as 🚩 flags and consumed by the lives authority as respawn points.
checkpoints.label: Checkpoints

equationColor.description: Color of the transient equation burst fired when a skate engages (and of telemetry text).
equationColor.label: Equation Color

fillDoneColor.description: Bar and lock-label color for closed star doors (amber; the bar disappears when the door opens).
fillDoneColor.label: Door Color

fxHitPuff.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for hit / info puffs.
fxHitPuff.label: FX Hit Puff Asset

fxPresets.description: Look table for world-space particle effects.
fxPresets.label: FX Presets

fxStarBurst.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for star-collect bursts.
fxStarBurst.label: FX Star Burst Asset

fxUnlockSparkle.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for unlock sparkles.
fxUnlockSparkle.label: FX Unlock Sparkle Asset

loopRings.description: Static arrow fields from the multivariable zones (vector steps, partials, gradient field, saddle trails, volume slabs), offset into world coordinates.
loopRings.label: Field Vectors

modRoadColor.description: Color of the reshaped road segment drawn once a coefficient pad applies (bright yellow — the lifted/tilted surface reads as the player's own edit).
modRoadColor.label: Modded Road Color

patrolColor.description: Marker color for the ✖ patrol bugs (danger red, both themes).
patrolColor.label: Patrol Color

playerSprite.description: Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for riya. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot.
playerSprite.label: Player Sprite Asset

reachRadius.description: A star's own radius (world units) — the gameTick collects a star when it overlaps riya's painted sprite box, extended by this padding.
reachRadius.label: Reach Radius

riyaColor.description: Core marker color for riya the dot (brand red — legible on dark and light themes).
riyaColor.label: Riya Color

riyaHaloColor.description: Soft halo ring under riya's core dot (8-digit hex with alpha).
riyaHaloColor.label: Riya Halo Color

riyaSpriteHeight.description: World-unit height of the riya sprite.
riyaSpriteHeight.label: Riya Sprite Height

riyaSpriteWidth.description: World-unit width of the riya sprite (scaled by the math-canvas x-axis pixel scale).
riyaSpriteWidth.label: Riya Sprite Width

showTelemetry.description: When true, draws a compact x/y/v readout on the canvas near riya (teaching/debug aid).
showTelemetry.label: Show Telemetry

spawnX.description: World x riya starts at (must match the lives authority's spawnX).
spawnX.label: Spawn X

starHaloColor.description: Soft glow ring under each uncollected star (8-digit hex with alpha).
starHaloColor.label: Star Halo Color

terrainColor.description: Bar color for the ground/platform/bridge bars.
terrainColor.label: Terrain Color

trailColor.description: Comet-trail dot color (8-digit hex with alpha); dots fade out by ttl via std-fx-trail.
trailColor.label: Trail Color

viewHalfWidth.description: Half the visible math window's width in world units — the camera clamps to [viewHalfWidth, worldWidth − viewHalfWidth].
viewHalfWidth.label: View Half Width

worldName.description: Display name shown in the in-flow top row as "riya · <worldName>".
worldName.label: World Name

worldWidth.description: Right edge of the world in math units (the final zone's exit); the camera and the body clamp against it.
worldWidth.label: World Width

yMax.description: Top edge of the fixed vertical window (covers every zone's tallest content).
yMax.label: Y Max

yMin.description: Bottom edge of the fixed vertical window (pit depth stays visible).
yMin.label: Y Min

zoneLabelColor.description: Color of the zone name markers floating at each zone's start.
zoneLabelColor.label: Zone Label Color

zoneLabelY.description: Height of the zone name markers (near the top of the fixed vertical window).
zoneLabelY.label: Zone Label Y

zones.description: The twenty-eight curriculum zones in run order: world-x span and family band color for the canvas region wash. Display names/concepts live on the zone-card config; equations and guides import from the atoms (entity.zoneMeta).
zones.label: Zones

emits.description: Run-left intent from ArrowLeft/KeyA keydown or d-pad (forwarded as STEER dir −1).
Run-right intent from ArrowRight/KeyD keydown or d-pad (forwarded as STEER dir +1).
Left/right key release (keyUpMap or d-pad release); forwarded as STEER dir 0.
Jump intent from Space/ArrowUp/KeyW or d-pad up; forwarded as the body authority's renamed JUMP (OW_LEAP), which accepts it only while grounded.
Renamed STEER consumed by the open world's platformer-body authority (−1/0/+1 × moveSpeed).
Renamed JUMP consumed by the open world's platformer-body authority (grounded-gated vertical kick).
Renamed PLACE consumed by the open world's platformer-body authority; respawn teleports (pit fall, life loss) and gate push-backs.
Damage bridge consumed by the lives authority (renamed DAMAGE); sources: fell, hazard tiles, patrol hits.
Pit-fall signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_FELL); riya teleports to the lives authority's checkpoint and pays one life.
Hazard-tile contact from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_HAZARD); bridged to OW_DAMAGE.
Patrol contact from the patrol-hazard authority (renamed PATROL_HIT); bridged to OW_DAMAGE with a 💥 burst.
Respawn point from the lives authority (renamed RESPAWN); forwarded to the body authority's PLACE.
A life was spent (renamed LIFE_LOST); 💔 burst + hearts HUD refresh.
Last life spent (renamed GAME_OVER from the lives authority); the play trait shows the game-over overlay.
Player pressed against a closed star door (renamed GATE_BLOCKED); the play trait pushes riya back and floats the cost.
A star door's cost was reached (renamed GATE_OPENED); 🔓 burst.
A full revolution around the treasure ring was completed (renamed LOOP_UNLOCKED); the play trait spills the chest's five bonus gems.
A velocity gate's speed band was satisfied — crossed in-band, or stillness held for the dwell (renamed VELOCITY_GATE_OPENED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around the gate.
The player entered a closed velocity gate outside its band or against its direction (renamed VELOCITY_GATE_DENIED); the play trait pushes riya back and floats the gate's hint.
The player landed on a wrong option platform (renamed CHOICE_WRONG); the play trait bounces riya back to the approach and floats the gate's hint.
The player landed on the correct option platform (renamed CHOICE_CORRECT); the gate is solved, the card dismisses, and the way to the reward cluster stays open.

The player rode over an unapplied coefficient pad (renamed COEF_PAD_APPLIED); the play trait appends the mod to the body authority's curveMods (the road reshapes under the next tick), stamps the precomputed modded segment for render, and hops riya onto the lifted surface.

Mod-application intent routed to the body authority (renamed CURVE_MOD_ADD, the single ordered writer of curveMods); the play trait emits it from OW_COEF_PAD_APPLIED instead of writing the body's field.
Range-scoped mod clear routed to the body authority (renamed CURVE_MOD_CLEAR_RANGE); the play trait emits it from OW_MOD_SINE_CLEAR so the sine quiz rebuilds only its own wave window.
Tuning broadcast consumed by the platformer-body authority (renamed SET_TUNING); the play trait emits the world defaults on every zone change so zone-local power-ups revert on zone exit.
Every coefficient pad applied (renamed COEF_PAD_SET_COMPLETED); the card dismisses and the completion burst fires. Grants no gems — the reward is access to the relocated stars.
One pad group fully lit (renamed PAD_GROUP_COMPLETED); the play trait floats a Σ row-complete burst. Later groups stay dead until the lowest uncompleted group finishes.
Every pad in the world lit (renamed PAD_SET_COMPLETED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around riya.
A fill region's painted area reached its target (renamed AREA_FILLED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around riya at the completion point.

Mechanic-progress broadcast (pad group/set, velocity gate, area fill, loop ring) that clears the zone card early — the card authority owns the shared card field, so dismissal routes through its CARD_DISMISS listen.

The player crossed into a different zone; the play trait swaps the HUD chip, skate equation and guides, fires the name banner, and the zone card holds name + concept + objective under the HUD until its ttl.
A zone-entry checkpoint was crossed (renamed CHECKPOINT_REACHED); 🚩 burst, respawn moved.
Skate slope crossed a 0.5 bucket (renamed SLOPE_CHANGED); refreshes the HUD dy/dx chip.
Running star total emitted by the pickup authority on every pickup (renamed COLLECT); the gate-lock authority opens doors whose cost it reaches and the play trait mirrors it into score.
Full collectible-set replacement consumed by the pickup authority (renamed SET_FEATURES); emitted by the merger at world assembly and by the play trait on replay.
Mid-game collectible drop (loop/vgate/pad/fill gem rewards) appended to the pickup authority's live set without re-arming collected stars.
Skate-engage signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_SKATE_START); riya touched a graph — fires the current zone's equation fx burst.
Skate-release signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_SKATE_END); clears the HUD slope chip.
Reseed broadcast consumed by every composed authority (body, gate, particles, patrols, lives, locks, trail, probe).
Broadcast when the lives authority spends the last life; the overlay authority (RiyaOwClear) shows the game-over menu.
Renamed SHOW consumed by the tutorial overlay authority (re-opens the GIF tutorial from step one).
Particle batch spawned on star pickup, zone entry, skate engage, damage, doors, checkpoints; fx-particles fades it.
Sparse progress signal emitted by the play trait on every pickup-authority OW_PICKED; the objective-flow gate resolves won from it.
Win-gate resolution from the objective-flow authority (renamed GAME_END); won clears the open world.
Every ★ on the whole line captured — the win gate resolved won (guarded by celebrated so the gate's repeated GAME_ENDs fire it once).
Real keyboard/d-pad input received; the composed autodemo atom stops its scripted replay and returns control to the player.

One-shot seed broadcast on INIT/replay carrying the board's static terrain, curve overlays, and stars; the tutorial preview trait mirrors it into its own entity so the modal can render a live bare-canvas frame without reading the shared game entity.

app riya-game-platformer-open-world "1.1.0"

;; CURRICULUM PROGRESSION (K-12 → undergraduate → postgraduate)
;; This open-world organism stitches the 28 riya-level-* atoms into one continuous
;; mathematical run. Each atom's header comment records its grade/level target.
;;   Foundations         : plain (number line), ramp (slope/rate)
;;   Algebra 1           : valley (quadratics), shifts (transformations), corner (piecewise), doubling (exponential growth intuition)
;;   Algebra 2 / Precalc : mountain (maxima), pole (asymptotes), log (logarithmic), cubic (inflection), gallery (Riemann sums), series (geometric), sine (periodic), vector (vectors), contour (level sets)
;;   Calculus 1          : deriv (derivative as slope), area (integral as accumulation), accum (FTC), decay (ODE y' = -ky), tail (improper integrals), limits (removable discontinuities), secant (difference quotient)
;;   Calculus 2          : taylor (polynomial approximation)
;;   Calculus 3          : partial (partial derivatives), gradient (directional steepest ascent), saddle (critical points), volume (iterated integrals)
;;   Postgrad bridge     : fourier (harmonic synthesis)
;; Pedagogical rule: the canvas teaches, not the HUD. Equations appear as FX bursts
;; when entering/skating a zone; the velocity vector arrow and field arrows are the
;; only persistent annotations. Dashed guide lines are reserved for mathematically
;; essential boundaries (asymptotes, domain walls, ceilings, summits) — everything
;; else is shown through terrain shape and FX.

"riya open world · The Open Line — all twenty-eight riya worlds stitched into ONE continuous 722-unit map you run left-to-right with a follow camera: the math window recenters on riya every frame (clamped to the world edges, with a small lead toward her facing), so the whole curriculum — number line → functions → limits → calculus → series → multivar → Fourier — is one unbroken run. Merged from the riya-level-* atoms' own data (platforms, stars, curve overlays, guides, field vectors, treasure rings, gates, pads, sequences, area fills, drift regions): each world keeps its exact terrain and pedagogy as a zone; staircase bridges climb/descend between zone exit and entry heights, and entering a zone fires a name banner and swaps the skate equation. Skating is global: every skate world's curve is concatenated into one strictly-increasing mega-curve for std-platformer-body, densely resampled (monotone cubic, kinks preserved) so the ride and the drawing are the same smooth surface. GAME ELEMENTS: ✖ patrol bugs pace beats in six zones (std-patrol-hazard) and cost a life on touch; three glowing star doors (std-gate-lock) open at 20/50/80 ★; a treasure ring floats above the Gallery bars — loop one full revolution around the floating chest (std-loop-lock tracks your winding angle: θ = 2π opens it) and it spills 5 bonus 💎★; two velocity gates (std-velocity-gate) guard bonus gems off the through-path — cross the Deriv ramp gate inside its speed band (your speed IS the derivative) and hold still at the Mountain summit (slope 0) until the dwell opens it; twelve floor pads (std-pad-lock) form one world-wide checklist — mirrored pairs on the Valley and Shifts parabolas (lighting one side demands its mirror), one pad on each Corner wall, and two ordered rows on the Volume slabs where the inner sum's row must finish before the outer's (Σ); the ground itself teaches too: Doubling's floating steps double their gaps until one beats any jump (take the spring), the Series steps converge under a bonus cluster that hovers at the limit, Decay's landing pads shrink ×0.7 each, the Pole's asymptote gets a star trail up the void, and Log's domain simply has no floor left of x = −7 — jump the gap; four area fills (std-area-fill) turn motion into painted integrals — shade the Area run's region by pacing it, climb the Accum gauge fastest on the bump's high shelf, finish the Tail's finite area long before its infinite run ends, and keep the Taylor ride-band alive only while truly skating the wave; drift fields push riya like weather — cubic's inflection tugs from both sides, the vector step is a constant right-up current, gradient's arrows are the easy path uphill, the saddle's downdraft slams every jump over the pass (the max shoves you back down to the trail), and the contour patrol bobs on a sine; checkpoints at every zone entry (std-lives) are the respawn — three lives, then game over → retry. MATH YOU FEEL: while skating, std-learn-slope-probe draws the live tangent line, a rise-over-run triangle, and a glowing curve window under riya, with a dy/dx chip in the HUD; std-fx-trail leaves a comet trail. A GIF tutorial modal (std-tutorial-overlay) teaches run/jump, skating, and stars-doors on first boot. Catch every ★ the line offers — stars and spilled gems alike — to clear it. Rendered through math-canvas on theme-token grid/axes with per-family zone bands."

  trait OwLevelMerger -> RiyaOwState [lifecycle] {
    initial: collecting

    state collecting {
      RIYA_LEVEL_DATA -> collecting
        (let ((z (array/first (array/filter @config.zoneOffsets (fn zz (== (object/get @zz id) @payload.id))))))
        (let ((dx (object/get @z dx)))
        (let ((rawCurves (array/concat
                (if (== @payload.curveOverlay null) [] @payload.curveOverlay)
                (array/concat
                  (if (== @payload.ghostCurves null) [] @payload.ghostCurves)
                  (array/concat
                    (if (== @payload.slopeCurves null) [] @payload.slopeCurves)
                    (array/concat
                      (if (== @payload.baseCurves null) [] @payload.baseCurves)
                      (array/concat
                        (if (== @payload.harmonicCurves null) [] @payload.harmonicCurves)
                        (array/concat
                          (if (== @payload.targetSquareWave null) [] [ { label: "target", color: "#fde047", dash: "dashed", samples: @payload.targetSquareWave } ])
                          (if (== @payload.sumSamples null) [] [ { label: "Σ sin(nx)/n", color: "#4ade80", samples: @payload.sumSamples } ])))))))))
        (let ((offCurves (array/map @rawCurves (fn c (object/merge @c { samples: (array/map (object/get @c samples) (fn s { x: (+ (object/get @s x) @dx), y: (object/get @s y) })) })))))
        (let ((offGuides (array/map (if (== @payload.guides null) [] @payload.guides) (fn g (object/merge @g { at: (if (== (object/get @g kind) "vline") (+ (object/get @g at) @dx) (object/get @g at)) })))))
        (let ((offSkate (array/map (if (== @payload.skateCurve null) [] @payload.skateCurve) (fn s { x: (+ (object/get @s x) @dx), y: (object/get @s y) }))))
        (do
          (set @entity.importsArrived (+ @entity.importsArrived 1))
          (set @entity.worldPlatforms (array/concat @entity.worldPlatforms (array/map @payload.platforms (fn p (object/merge @p { id: (str/concat @payload.id "-" (object/get @p id)), x: (+ (object/get @p x) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.worldStars (array/concat @entity.worldStars (array/map (array/concat @payload.stars (if (== @payload.ceilingStars null) [] @payload.ceilingStars)) (fn s (object/merge @s { id: (str/concat @payload.id "-" (object/get @s id)), x: (+ (object/get @s x) @dx), type: (object/get @s kind "star") })))))
          (set @entity.worldCurves (array/concat @entity.worldCurves @offCurves))
          (set @entity.worldHops (array/concat @entity.worldHops (array/map (if (== @payload.hops null) [] @payload.hops) (fn h (object/merge @h { from: (+ (object/get @h from) @dx), to: (+ (object/get @h to) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.worldVectors (array/concat @entity.worldVectors (array/map (if (== @payload.fieldVectors null) [] @payload.fieldVectors) (fn v (object/merge @v { x: (+ (object/get @v x) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.worldSkate (array/concat @entity.worldSkate @offSkate))
          (set @entity.worldDrifts (array/concat @entity.worldDrifts (array/map (if (== @payload.driftRegions null) [] @payload.driftRegions) (fn r (object/merge @r { x0: (+ (object/get @r x0) @dx), x1: (+ (object/get @r x1) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.worldPads (array/concat @entity.worldPads (array/map (if (== @payload.pads null) [] @payload.pads) (fn p (object/merge @p { id: (str/concat @payload.id "-" (object/get @p id)), x: (+ (object/get @p x) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.worldChoices (array/concat @entity.worldChoices (array/map (array/concat (if (== @payload.choiceGates null) [] @payload.choiceGates) (if (== @payload.gates null) [] @payload.gates)) (fn g (object/merge @g { id: (str/concat @payload.id "-" (object/get @g id)), x: (+ (object/get @g x) @dx) })))))
          (set @entity.zoneMeta (array/append @entity.zoneMeta { id: @payload.id, name: @payload.name, equation: @payload.equation, concept: @payload.concept, regionColor: @payload.regionColor, entryY: @payload.entryY, exitY: @payload.exitY, guides: @offGuides }))
          (set @entity.roadRegions (array/concat @entity.roadRegions (if (> (array/len @offSkate) 1) [ { id: (str/concat @payload.id "-road"), samples: @offSkate, baseline: -3, color: @payload.regionColor, opacity: 0.25 } ] [])))
          (if (== @payload.id "sine")
            (do
              (set @entity.sineBase @dx)
              (set @entity.sineX0 (object/get (array/first @offSkate) x))
              (set @entity.sineX1 (object/get (array/last @offSkate) x)))
            null)
          (if (== @entity.importsArrived 28)
            (do
              (emit OW_SET_PLATFORMS { platforms: (array/concat @entity.worldPlatforms (array/concat @config.bridges @config.ringPlatforms)) })
              (emit OW_SET_SKATE_CURVE { curve: @entity.worldSkate })
              (emit OW_SET_PROBE_CURVE { curve: @entity.worldSkate })
              (emit OW_SET_DRIFT_REGIONS { regions: @entity.worldDrifts })
              (emit OW_SET_PADS { pads: (array/concat @config.valleyPads @entity.worldPads) })
              (emit OW_SET_GATES { gates: @entity.worldChoices })
              (emit OW_SET_FEATURES { features: @entity.worldStars })
              (emit OW_WORLD_ASSEMBLED {}))
            null))))))))
    }

            xMax: (+ (math/clamp (+ (+ @entity.body.x 0.3) (if @entity.body.facingRight @config.camLead (- 0 @config.camLead))) @config.viewHalfWidth (- @config.worldWidth @config.viewHalfWidth)) @config.viewHalfWidth)

            yMax: @config.yMax

            tickLabelFontSize: 14
            labelFontSize: 18

            guides: @entity.zoneGuides
            hops: @entity.worldHops
            regions: (array/concat
              (array/map @config.zones (fn z { samples: [ { x: (object/get @z x0), y: @config.yMax } { x: (object/get @z x1), y: @config.yMax } ], baseline: @config.yMin, color: (object/get @z band), opacity: 0.07 }))
              (array/concat @entity.fogRegionsVisible @entity.fogRegionsGhost)
              (array/map @entity.fills (fn f { samples: (array/filter (object/get @f samples) (fn smp (<= (object/get @smp x) (object/get @f frontier)))), baseline: (object/get @f baseline), color: (if (object/get @f reported) @config.fillDoneColor @config.fillColor), opacity: 0.25, label: (str/concat "∫ = " (math/round (object/get @f filled) 0) " ⁄ " (object/get @f target)) })))

              (array/map @config.loopRings (fn r { label: "", color: @config.loopRingColor, dash: "dashed", samples: (object/get @r samples) }))
              (array/map @config.loopRings (fn r { label: "", color: @config.loopSweepColor, samples: (array/filter (object/get @r samples) (fn s (or (object/get (array/first @entity.locks) unlocked) (<= (object/get @s a) (math/abs (object/get (array/first @entity.locks) swept)))))) }))) [])
              (array/concat @entity.fogCurves
              (array/concat @entity.fogGhostCurves
              (array/concat (if (> (array/len @entity.curveModSamples) 0) [ { label: "", color: @config.modRoadColor, samples: @entity.curveModSamples } ] [])
              (array/concat
              (array/map (array/filter @entity.gates (fn g (== (object/get @g open) false))) (fn g { label: "", color: @config.vgateColor, dash: "dashed", samples: [ { x: (+ (object/get @g x) (* (object/get @g width) 0.5)), y: (object/get @g y) } { x: (+ (object/get @g x) (* (object/get @g width) 0.5)), y: (+ (object/get @g y) (object/get @g height)) } ] }))

    ticks {
      gameTick every 50ms when (and (== @entity.active true) (and (== @entity.over false) (and (== @entity.result "none") (> @entity.body.width 0))))
        (set @entity.frame (+ @entity.frame 1))

      fogTick every 50ms when (and (== @entity.active true) (and (== @entity.over false) (and (== @entity.result "none") (> @entity.body.width 0))))
        (if (or (> (math/abs (- @entity.fogX @entity.fogStampX)) 0.25) (!= (array/len @entity.curveMods) @entity.fogStampMods))
          (do
            (set @entity.fogStampX @entity.fogX)
            (set @entity.fogStampMods (array/len @entity.curveMods))
            (set @entity.fogCurves (array/map @entity.worldCurves (fn c (object/merge @c { samples: (array/filter (object/get @c samples) (fn s (and (<= (object/get @s x) @entity.fogX) (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.curveMods (fn m (and (>= (object/get @s x) (object/get @m x0)) (<= (object/get @s x) (object/get @m x1)))))) 0)))) }))))
            (set @entity.fogGhostCurves (array/map @entity.worldCurves (fn c (object/merge @c { color: (str/concat (object/get @c color) "1A"), samples: (array/filter (object/get @c samples) (fn s (or (> (object/get @s x) @entity.fogX) (> (array/len (array/filter @entity.curveMods (fn m (and (>= (object/get @s x) (object/get @m x0)) (<= (object/get @s x) (object/get @m x1)))))) 0)))) }))))
            (set @entity.fogRegionsVisible (array/map @entity.roadRegions (fn r { id: (object/get @r id), samples: (array/filter (object/get @r samples) (fn s (<= (object/get @s x) @entity.fogX))), baseline: (object/get @r baseline), color: (object/get @r color), opacity: (object/get @r opacity) })))

          null)

    }

  trait RiyaOwPreview -> RiyaOwPreviewData [interaction, instance] {
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle
        (render-ui center @config.bodyContent)

      OW_PREVIEW_SEED -> idle
        (set @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.x 2.3)
        (set @entity.y 1.3)
        (set @entity.dir 0)
        (set @entity.vy 0)
        (set @entity.grounded true)
        (set @entity.platforms @payload.platforms)
        (set @entity.curves @payload.curves)
        (set @entity.features @payload.features)

      OW_DEMO_LEFT -> idle
        (set @entity.dir -1)

      OW_DEMO_RIGHT -> idle
        (set @entity.dir 1)

      OW_DEMO_JUMP -> idle when (== @entity.grounded true)
        (set @entity.vy @config.jumpStrength)
        (set @entity.grounded false)

      OW_DEMO_STOP -> idle
        (set @entity.dir 0)

      OW_TUT_SHOW -> idle
        (set @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.x 2.3)
        (set @entity.y 1.3)
        (set @entity.dir 0)
        (set @entity.vy 0)
        (set @entity.grounded true)
        (render-ui center @config.bodyContent)

      OW_TUT_DONE -> idle
        (set @entity.active false)
    }

    ticks {
      previewTick every 50ms when (== @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.x (+ @entity.x (* @entity.dir @config.moveSpeed 0.05)))
        (if (== @entity.grounded false)
          (do
            (set @entity.vy (- @entity.vy (* @config.gravity 0.05)))
            (set @entity.y (+ @entity.y (* @entity.vy 0.05)))
            (if (<= @entity.y @config.groundY)
              (do
                (set @entity.y @config.groundY)
                (set @entity.vy 0)
                (set @entity.grounded true))
              null))
          null)
    }

    listens {
      OW_PREVIEW_SEED {
        platforms : [RiyaOwPlatform]!
        curves : [RiyaOwCurve]!
        features : [RiyaOwStar]!
      }
      OW_DEMO_LEFT {
      }
      OW_DEMO_RIGHT {
      }
      OW_DEMO_JUMP {
      }
      OW_DEMO_STOP {
      }
      OW_TUT_SHOW {
      }
      OW_TUT_DONE {
      }
    }

    config {
      bodyContent : render-ui = {
        type: math-canvas
        width: @config.width
        height: @config.height
        xMin: (- (math/clamp @entity.x @config.viewHalfWidth (- @config.worldWidth @config.viewHalfWidth)) @config.viewHalfWidth)
        xMax: (+ (math/clamp @entity.x @config.viewHalfWidth (- @config.worldWidth @config.viewHalfWidth)) @config.viewHalfWidth)
        yMin: @config.yMin
        yMax: @config.yMax
        showTickLabels: true
        tickLabelFontSize: 14
        labelFontSize: 18
        fontFamily: "pixel"
        curves: @entity.curves
        bars: (array/map @entity.platforms (fn p { x: (object/get @p x), width: (object/get @p width), y0: (object/get @p y), y1: (+ (object/get @p y) (object/get @p height)), color: @config.terrainColor, opacity: 0.85 }))
        drawables: (if (!= (object/get @config.playerSprite "url") "") [ {
          type: "draw-sprite"
          position: { x: @entity.x, y: @entity.y }
          asset: @config.playerSprite
          animation: (if @entity.grounded (if (!= @entity.dir 0) "skate" "idle") (if (> @entity.vy 0) "jump" "fall"))
          flipX: (< @entity.dir 0)
          width: @config.riyaSpriteWidth
          height: @config.riyaSpriteHeight
          anchor: "ground"
        } ] [])
        points: (array/concat
          (array/map @entity.features (fn f { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y), label: "", color: @config.starHaloColor, radius: 9 }))
          (array/map @entity.features (fn f { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y), label: "★", color: @config.starColor, radius: 6 }))
          [ { x: @entity.x, y: @entity.y, label: "", color: @config.riyaHaloColor, radius: 10 } ]
          (if (!= (object/get @config.playerSprite "url") "") [] [ { x: @entity.x, y: @entity.y, label: "riya", color: @config.riyaColor, radius: 5 } ]))
      }
        @label "Body content tree"
        @description "Render-ui SExpr for the tutorial preview frame: a bare math-canvas following the demo-driven body position, seeded from the board's static terrain/curves/stars."
        @tier "internal"
      width : number = 400
        @label "Canvas Width"
        @description "math-canvas display width in px for the tutorial preview frame."
        @tier "presentation"
      height : number = 240
        @label "Canvas Height"
        @description "math-canvas display height in px for the tutorial preview frame."
        @tier "presentation"
      moveSpeed : number = 5
        @label "Move Speed"
        @description "Horizontal run speed of the demo-driven preview mirror (world units/sec), matching the play canvas."
        @tier "presentation"
      gravity : number = 24
        @label "Gravity"
        @description "Downward acceleration for the preview jump arc (world units/sec²), matching the play body."
        @tier "presentation"
      jumpStrength : number = 11
        @label "Jump Strength"
        @description "Initial vertical velocity of the preview jump (world units/sec), matching the play body."
        @tier "presentation"
      groundY : number = 1.3
        @label "Ground Y"
        @description "Marker rest height in the preview (spawn ground top + marker offset); the preview jump arc lands here."
        @tier "presentation"
      viewHalfWidth : number = 11
        @label "View Half Width"
        @description "Half the visible preview window in world units, matching the play canvas."
        @tier "presentation"
      worldWidth : number = 722
        @label "World Width"
        @description "Right edge of the world; the preview camera clamps against it."
        @tier "presentation"
      playerSprite : RiyaOwAsset = { url: "https://almadar-kflow-assets.web.app/shared/riya-platformer/units/riya/riya_sprite_sheet.png", atlas: "https://almadar-kflow-assets.web.app/shared/riya-platformer/units/riya/atlas.json", role: "player", category: "sprite" }
        @label "Preview Player Sprite Asset"
        @description "Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for the live tutorial preview. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot."
        @tier "presentation"
      riyaSpriteWidth : number = 1.8
        @label "Preview Riya Sprite Width"
        @description "World-unit width of the preview riya sprite."
        @tier "presentation"
      riyaSpriteHeight : number = 1.8
        @label "Preview Riya Sprite Height"
        @description "World-unit height of the preview riya sprite."
        @tier "presentation"
      yMin : number = -3
        @label "Y Min"
        @description "Bottom edge of the preview window."
        @tier "presentation"
      yMax : number = 12
        @label "Y Max"
        @description "Top edge of the preview window."
        @tier "presentation"
      terrainColor : string = "#78716c"
        @label "Terrain Color"
        @description "Bar color for ground/platform bars in the preview."
        @tier "presentation"
      starColor : string = "#f59e0b"
        @label "Star Color"
        @description "Marker color for uncollected stars in the preview."
        @tier "presentation"
      starHaloColor : string = "#f59e0b33"
        @label "Star Halo Color"
        @description "Soft glow ring under each star in the preview."
        @tier "presentation"
      riyaColor : string = "#dc2626"
        @label "Riya Color"
        @description "Core marker color for riya in the preview."
        @tier "presentation"

  trait RiyaOwClear -> @rebindable RiyaOwState [interaction, instance] {
    initial: watching

    state watching {
      INIT -> watching
        (render-ui overlay null)

      RIYA_WORLD_SOLVED -> watching
        (render-ui overlay {
          type: game-menu
          title: @config.clearTitle
          subtitle: @config.clearSubtitle
          options: [ { id: "replay", label: "Run again ▶", event: "OW_NEXT", variant: "primary" } ]
        })

      RIYA_WORLD_FAILED -> watching
        (render-ui overlay {
          type: game-menu
          title: @config.gameOverTitle
          subtitle: @config.gameOverSubtitle
          options: [ { id: "retry", label: "Try again ▶", event: "OW_NEXT", variant: "primary" } ]
        })

      OW_NEXT -> watching
        (render-ui overlay null)
        (emit OW_REPLAY {})

      CLOSE -> watching
        (render-ui overlay null)
    }

    listens {
      RIYA_WORLD_SOLVED { level : string }
      RIYA_WORLD_FAILED { level : string }
      OW_NEXT { id : string }
      CLOSE
    }

    emits {
      OW_REPLAY -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Replay broadcast emitted when the clear overlay's Run-again button fires; the play trait listens and reseeds the run in place (no navigation — the open world is a single page)."
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      clearTitle : string = "The whole line, end to end ★"
        @label "Clear Title"
        @description "Overlay title once every star on the line is collected."
        @tier "presentation"
      clearSubtitle : string = "From a number you stand on to a sum of sums — you ran all of it."
        @label "Clear Subtitle"
        @description "One-line celebration under the clear title."
        @tier "presentation"
      gameOverTitle : string = "Out of lives 💔"
        @label "Game Over Title"
        @description "Overlay title when the third life is spent."
        @tier "presentation"
      gameOverSubtitle : string = "The line is patient — run it again."
        @label "Game Over Subtitle"
        @description "One-line encouragement under the game-over title."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }
